title: Mimì?!
subtitle: Marcello finds Mimì at the toll gate and she begs him to help her and Rodolfo part, La bohème, Act 3

passages.label: Marcello comes out of the tavern: the month he and Musetta have spent there
C'è Rodolfo? Mimì cannot go in: Rodolfo's jealousy (Andante)
Un passo, un detto: his suspicions, Mi grida ad ogni istante
Quando s'è come voi: they had better part (I.° Tempo)
Rodolfo asleep inside; Da ieri ho l'ossa rotte (Andante mosso)
Rodolfo wakes: Marcello sends Mimì home, and she hides (Allegretto)

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 179-191 (from Marcello's entrance, page 179 system 3, across the Allegro at figure (8), to the end of page 191, before Rodolfo's entrance, 113 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. The unlabelled instrumental staff printed above the piano on page 191 (bars 102-108) is played in the piano's right hand. Tempo from the printed Andante ♩ = 48 at figure (9), which returns as I.° Tempo and, as "lo stesso movimento", at the Andante mosso; bars 1-3 continue Act 3's Andantino mosso ♩ = 112 (page 167); the Allegro, Moderato, Vivo, Sostenendo molto, Lento a piacere, Allegretto and Poco meno are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
